title: fix(spec,test): unblock the 19 Version PR: open the major-19 registry regions, parse prerelease versions in the MCP save test, key the objectui pin claim on the spec major
body:
Fixes #37549

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：发版流程里，版本号升到 19 之后，有三处会红，这里一起修掉：迁移登记表的生成不会再拒收第 19 版的下线条目；MCP 保存草稿的一条测试不再把预发布版本号（19.0.0-next.0）读坏；界面仓的版本说法检查不再写死 18。"版本发布"那个 PR 的核心测试和界面测试可以变绿。
- 为什么做：给发第一个 19 预发布版（next 渠道）清掉阻断。版本 PR 的必过检查一直是红的，现在没法合并。
- 出错会怎样：只给模板加了两个空区段，另外改了三份测试；不改任何已发布行为。出问题直接撤回这个 PR 即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`: opens an empty `retired-key:19` region in `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` and an empty `retired-def:19` region in `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR`, each placed and shaped like its major-18 sibling. `semantic:19` and `step19` already existed, so the migration-step side needed nothing.
- `retired-def:19` goes beyond the card's wording, as an in-place fix of the same defect class. `build-schemas.ts` prescribes new retired-def entry files under the same `CURRENT_MAJOR` (`renderNewEntryFiles`, used for both kinds). So the first whole-def removal on the 19 tree would have hit the same generator refusal. Same file, same gate family, same mechanical fix.
- `scripts/build-migration-registry.ts` needs no change. Its lines ~422–441 are `--self-test` fixtures, not a region list: the generator discovers regions from the template's markers.
- Pin (`packages/spec/scripts/build-migration-registry-entry.test.ts`, new `describe`): every kind in `KINDS` has an open and close marker in the template for each of two majors, the spec package's major (what `build-schemas.ts` registers new entries under) and `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`. On `main` today these are 18 and 19, so the pin reds on `main` before the fix and names the missing region and the major.
  - Why `PROTOCOL_MAJOR` and not "spec major + 1": the protocol major moves first, on `main` (it reads 19 while the package is still 18.6.0). It is the leading signal for the next major.
  - "spec major + 1" would also red the Version PR tree itself (19 + 1 = 20), unless a major-20 region were opened now.
- Item 2 (seat-amended scope, card #37549): `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`. The `[#34774]` describe parsed `SERVER` with `split('.')`, so on the Version PR tree (`19.0.0-next.0`) the patch field was `0-next` and the built version was `19.0.NaN`, which the door refuses as not SemVer. It now parses with `SEMVER_2_0_0_VERSION_PATTERN` from `@objectstack/spec/kernel`, the grammar the door itself judges with, and drops the prerelease from the versions it builds. A new case declares the server's own version verbatim and `${major}.${minor}.0-next.0`, and asserts both save byte-identically to no declaration. Test-only; `@objectstack/runtime` ships `dist` alone, so no runtime changeset is owed.
- Item 3 (seat-amended scope): `ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`. The `skills/objectui/SKILL.md` KNOWN_CLAIMS row was the literal `@objectstack/spec 18.x`. It is now keyed on `SPEC_MAJOR`, read from `packages/spec/package.json` under `workspaceRoot()`. The literal in the skill can't go, because the root `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs` requires the pin and rewrites it with the version step. So `skills/**` is not touched, and the PR stays off Tier H.
- Changeset `.changeset/37549-retired-key-19-region.md` (patch; the template renders into the shipped `registry.ts`).

## Acceptance notes

- In-flight spec PRs #37366, #37371 and #37422: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --pr=37366,37371,37422` gives `VERDICT clean exit 0`. Their migration changes are major-18 semantic entry files only, and none touches the template.
- L2: the template is the generator's skeleton for a gitignored generated file. The two regions are empty, so no exported value or key changes shape: `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[19]` / `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[19]` become empty arrays.

Body amended by the seat (repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA) to cover the three items the card's scope grew to; the dev report on #37549 (7194227076) carries the full evidence.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 scripts/build-migration-registry-entry.test.ts`, expected to show `Tests 10 passed (10)`. Then set the spec version to `19.0.0-next.0` and run `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.retired-keys.test.ts`, which should also be green.

Read first: (1) the two new template regions; (2) the pin's choice of majors (spec package major and `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`).

Local gate subset at 2fd0411761: derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`. Verdicts are in the dev report on the card. `check:doc-formula-expressions` is NOT MEASURED locally (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` are not built in this worktree); CI runs it. The full farm belongs to CI.
